how: Each page was fetched once with an honest user agent; robots.txt was read and respected. 'feed' pages have a documented public JSON feed and are read by an adapter. 'manual' pages are reachable and not disallowed, but have no documented feed: open them in a browser and paste an ad into `draft`. Nothing is scraped and no block is bypassed.
